name: Corpus Verification Paths
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = policy/data, `(O)` = operation. Tagged labels map to source code.

                         CORPUS INTERACTION AND VERIFICATION

 [D] DomainProfile / SOURCE_CODE_PROFILE / DOCUMENT_PROFILE
     src/domainProfiles.ts
       |
       | explorer tabs + Corpus/Evidence schema + source/Markdown presentation
       v
 (O) FileExplorerPanel.revealEntity
     src/components/FileExplorerPanel.tsx
       |
       +---- direct Corpus browse: filtered path/list -------------------------------+
       |                                                                            |
       +---- associated file/entity ---> CodeEntities as Evidence                   |
                                             | linked path + exact ranges            |
                                             v                                       |
 (O) CodeEntitiesPanel.selectEntity / openLinkedAnchor                              |
     src/components/CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx                                            |
       | validate anchor / request `DiagramApplication.sourceSnippet`                |
       +---------------------------------------------+-------------------------------+
                                                     v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [D] CORPUS = BOUNDED AUTHORITATIVE VERIFICATION SURFACE                                          |
|                                                                                                  |
|  (O) FilesystemCorpusProvider / bounded verification                                             |
|      server/corpus.ts                                                                            |
|      rejects traversal; safely lists and reads only content inside the configured Corpus         |
|      direct path: `listRepositoryDirectory`; Evidence path: validated `sourceSnippet`            |
|                                                                                                  |
|  owns the full document and dispatches its presentation under DomainProfile policy               |
|       |                                                                                          |
|       +---- source code ----> (O) SourceCodeView                                                  |
|       |                       src/components/SourceCodeView.tsx                                   |
|       |                       exact line selection/highlight; reversible compacted-span reveal    |
|       |                                                                                          |
|       +---- document -------> (O) TerminalMarkdownView / MarkdownSectionsPanel                    |
|                               src/components/TerminalMarkdownView.tsx                             |
|                               src/components/MarkdownSectionsPanel.tsx                            |
|                               sandboxed render + outline/active section + section/recent jumps    |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 (O) HighlightsTreePanel.revealHighlight
     src/components/HighlightsTreePanel.tsx; src/App.tsx
       | persistent artifact lineage + Evidence link
       | restore artifact + open linked source range
       +-----------------------------------------+
                                                 |
 Markdown section selection / recent-jump replay +
                                                 v
 (O) PaneNavigationApi
     src/panes/navigation.ts
       | activate/focus; bounded deduplicated history; delay until handler; replay/clear
       |
       +---- source-location / Evidence replay ----> exact source workspace ----> Corpus
       |
       +---- section replay ------------------------> sandboxed Markdown document
       |
       +<---------------- reversible prior-jump navigation ----------------------+
